name: Book of N'Zoth adds one native max stack to Shadow of the Void (#1090)
contract: 806768 effect0 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 31 = SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS, BasePoints 0 / DieSides 1 -> value 1, matching the tooltip's $s1=1. SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod (SpellInfo.cpp ~1503) already routes it by an explicit case in the family-31 collision table: `case 806768: return Id == 300277;` (alongside 681102/681389), so it is not blocked by the classmask collision the family shares with other Cultist spells. SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks (~1451) reads Shadow of the Void's own Spell.dbc StackAmount (1) and applies this exact modifier via Player::ApplySpellMod. The harness's spell_max_stacks metric calls CalcMaxAuraStacks directly, so it observes the native routed modifier without needing to actually stack the aura to its cap.

steps.label: SETUP: Shadow of the Void's native max stack is 1 before the talent
Book of N'Zoth raises the native max stack to 2
